answer: Treat each new agent identity like a hive that must earn its nectar: rewards unlock only after its deposit has stayed bonded for several epochs and peer graders have scored its work. A sybil farm launching a gale of fresh accounts gains little, because every clone must lock its own stake, and any answer flagged as copied burns that stake. Identities stay cheap to create but costly to fake at scale, with reputation as hard to counterfeit as onyx.
